about: Pictures painted on the robot where robot3d draws no text: crops of the owner's photos of the robot (straightened, saved without their metadata), in data/decals/. Each on a part (robot.glb's), on its side facing face, with its top left, top right and bottom left corners where they lie at rest (mm, robot3d's space).

decals.about: the base's bottom cover: its label, rubber strips, screws and M5 logo (the owner's photo of the bottom, straightened by its four screws onto the cover's screw holes, x ±9 mm, z 26.37 and -17.63; the front, its notch, at the top)
the sticker on the left side (the owner's photo; the front at the left, its dark end at the top)
the sticker on the right side: the left one turned round (its dark end at the bottom, as on M5Stack's photo of the right side)
